en: A hand-colored early-20th-century postcard depicting a historic multi-story Renaissance-style town hall with ornate bay windows and a green copper dome on the corner turret. The building has many rectangular windows and decorative reliefs on the facade, with shops and awnings at street level. At the bottom of the card, printed text identifies the location and publisher, including the words "Torgau. Rathaus." and a 1904 publication line.
